question: When a page is read again and its bytes are unchanged, the capture store keeps the first sidecar, so an evidence row dated on the later day cites a capture whose fetched_at is earlier. Should the store keep the latest fetch time, or should a row carry the date of the first capture?
why: This unit dropped four rows of email/yandex-360 dated 2026-10-31 that cite capture 8783018f (fetched 2026-10-30T13:02:40Z) and added rows dated 2026-11-02 that cite a capture fetched that day by another reader. email/sendgrid (rows dated 2026-10-31 citing 6eb98553 and f87d0c32), email/mailersend (rows citing e001c623, b5ef3fb2 and e04f553a) and email/yandex-360 (rows citing fa6a0062) still hold the same pattern, fetched 2026-10-30; a rule would let a lane avoid dropping rows.
